about.title: About TIME BRIDGE
about.lead: TIME BRIDGE is a Japan-based supplier of vintage and pre-owned watches for dealers and retailers. We source across Japan, check every piece ourselves and ship worldwide by DHL or UPS.

stats.label: in international trade and exporting from Japan
vintage watches sold to collectors and dealers worldwide
orders ship within 3 business days by DHL or UPS

points.p: Our founder has worked in exporting from Japan since 2017, starting at a textile trading company. Export paperwork and international shipping are part of our everyday work.
Japan is one of the best places to find well-kept vintage watches. We buy regularly from Japanese trade auctions and dealers, and list only the pieces that pass our selection.
Every watch is checked for running condition and photographed in detail, so you can judge the dial, case and bracelet before you buy.
Orders ship within 3 business days by DHL or UPS with tracking, packed for international transit. Import duties are paid on delivery (DAP).
Follow our WhatsApp channel for our wholesale price list, then add pieces to your order and pay by Wise bank transfer or PayPal invoice.
Tell us the brands and models you are looking for — we watch our sources and let you know first when they come in.
